assets/images/elder-sailor-image-atlas-r.source: Historical r05 atlas, preserved for comparison. Does not satisfy the latest skirt-only extra-geometry requirement; not used by the current r06 video.

r06 ImageGen-painted V collar and large bow on the original body UV atlas; protected original face, hands and exposed neck pixels restored. Original 3D skirt retained as the sole clothing geometry. Not embedded again in game HTML. Superseded by r07 for the current video.

r07: r06 upper costume kept; ImageGen-painted lower body (leotard, bare legs, knee-high boots, boot feet) on the original UV islands; protected face, hands and exposed neck pixels unchanged. Original 3D skirt retained as the sole clothing geometry. Not embedded in game HTML.
